housing.summary: Numbeo reports an August 2026 average of USD 1,971.19 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Philadelphia city centre: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Philadelphia Pennsylvania law caps a first-year residential security deposit at two months of rent and one month in later years: https://www.legis.state.pa.us/WU01/LI/LI/US/HTM/1951/0/0020.005.000..HTM Zillow provides the Philadelphia rentals portal: https://www.zillow.com/philadelphia-pa/rentals/

banking.summary: Chase says non-residents may need government-issued photo identification, proof of a U.S. address and possibly an opening deposit; an ITIN may substitute for an SSN where accepted: https://www.chase.com/personal/banking/education/basics/us-bank-account-for-non-residents
required_docs: Official government-issued photo identification such as a passport
Proof of U.S. address showing name and address
SSN if required, or an ITIN where accepted as a substitute

schools.summary: William W. Bodine High School in Philadelphia offers the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme: https://bodine.philasd.org/international-baccalaureate-program/ The School District of Philadelphia online directory searches schools by name, location number or ZIP code: https://apps1.philasd.org/onlinedirectory/

legal_admin.summary: The United States has no Philadelphia-specific residence registration in the cited source. Noncitizens subject to USCIS address reporting must report a change of address within 10 days; A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors are exempt: https://www.uscis.gov/ar-11
legal_admin.registration_step: If subject to the USCIS address-reporting rule, report a change of address within 10 days through a USCIS online account or by mailing Form AR-11.

tax_finance.summary: A newcomer who is not eligible for an SSN but needs a U.S. tax-processing number can apply to the IRS for an ITIN using Form W-7, generally with a federal tax return and proof of foreign status and identity: https://www.irs.gov/tin/itin/how-to-apply-for-an-itin

transport.summary: The Southeastern Pennsylvania Transportation Authority (SEPTA) is the main public-transport network; its Monthly TransPass+ costs USD 116: https://wwww.septa.org/fares/
transport.driving_licence_exchange: PennDOT does not state a direct foreign-licence exchange procedure on the cited page; an eligible driver may use a valid foreign licence for up to one year from U.S. entry or until that licence expires, whichever comes first, and an international driving permit is recommended but not required. https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dmv/faqs/miscellaneous-faqs
transport.healthcare_registration: Public coverage is eligibility-based, not automatic. Apply for Pennsylvania Medicaid, called Medical Assistance, online through COMPASS or through a County Assistance Office, by phone or by mail; identity, income, residency and citizenship or lawful-status documentation may be required. https://www.pa.gov/services/dhs/apply-for-medicaid-benefits
